meaning.en: Willow branches swaying gently, evoking spring or parting.
meaning.zh: 杨柳枝条轻轻随风飘拂，常用来写春景或离别的情意。

examples.zh: 河岸边杨柳依依，春意盎然。
examples.en: Willows sway softly along the bank, full of spring.

examples.zh: 想起当年杨柳依依的离别，他不禁伤感。
examples.en: Recalling the parting among the swaying willows, he felt wistful.

examples.zh: 春风里，杨柳依依，燕子归来。
examples.en: In the spring breeze the willows sway and the swallows return.

story.en: Book of Songs: 'When I left, the willows swayed softly' (昔我往矣，杨柳依依).
story.zh: 《诗经》：“昔我往矣，杨柳依依。今我来思，雨雪霏霏。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.zh: 多用于描写景物，常见于诗文。

meaning.en: A face glowing with cheer and satisfaction.
meaning.zh: 形容满脸笑容，心情愉快。

examples.zh: 他今天满面春风，想必有喜事。
examples.en: He is beaming today; there must be good news.

examples.zh: 新郎满面春风地迎接宾客。
examples.en: The groom greeted the guests all smiles.

examples.zh: 老师满面春风地走进教室。
examples.en: The teacher walked into the classroom beaming.

meaning.en: Conveying the circumstances and views of ordinary people to those in authority.
meaning.zh: 把基层群众的情况和意见反映给上级。

equivalents: let the public voice be heard

examples.zh: 要建立渠道，保证下情上达。
examples.en: Channels must be set up so that grassroots views reach the top.

examples.zh: 下情上达，上情下达，政令才能畅通。
examples.en: With information flowing up and down, policy can move smoothly.

examples.zh: 信访制度的目的是让下情上达。
examples.en: The petition system aims to let the public's concerns reach the authorities.

usage.en: Official register; often paired with 上情下达.
usage.zh: 公文用语，常与“上情下达”并用。

meaning.en: To serve someone devotedly, always at their side.
meaning.zh: 在别人身前身后殷勤地服侍，形容尽心效劳。

equivalents: be at someone's beck and call

examples.zh: 这些年他一直在老板鞍前马后地忙活。
examples.en: All these years he has been serving the boss at every turn.

examples.zh: 她愿意为你鞍前马后，在所不辞。
examples.en: She will gladly serve you at your side, whatever it takes.

examples.zh: 我给你鞍前马后跑了一天，也该歇歇了。
examples.en: I've run around after you all day; I should rest.

usage.en: Often 为……鞍前马后; can be playful or mildly derogatory.
usage.zh: 常说“为……鞍前马后”，有时带调侃或贬义。

meaning.en: A violent wind that sends sand and stones flying.
meaning.zh: 沙石被狂风吹得飞扬滚动，形容风势猛烈。

examples.zh: 大风骤起，飞沙走石，天昏地暗。
examples.en: A gale rose, sand and stones flew and the sky went dark.

examples.zh: 沙漠里飞沙走石，行人寸步难行。
examples.en: With sand and stones flying in the desert, walkers could hardly advance.

examples.zh: 台风登陆时飞沙走石。
examples.en: When the typhoon made landfall, grit and stones whirled through the air.

meaning.en: Large but not practical or fit for purpose.
meaning.zh: 虽然很大，但不合用，不切实际。

examples.zh: 这个方案大而无当，根本没法执行。
examples.en: The plan is grandiose but impractical and can't be carried out.

examples.zh: 别搞大而无当的项目。
examples.en: Don't take on projects that are big and pointless.

examples.zh: 他的理论大而无当，缺乏依据。
examples.en: His theory is sweeping but baseless.

story.en: Zhuangzi: Jian Wu says Jie Yu's words are 'big and without fit' (大而无当), leaving no way back.
story.zh: 《庄子》：“吾闻言于接舆，大而无当，往而不反。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

meaning.en: Having a fierce, hideous look.
meaning.zh: 脸色凶恶可怕，样子难看。

examples.zh: 壁画上的恶鬼面目狰狞。
examples.en: The demon in the mural has a hideous face.

examples.zh: 歹徒面目狰狞，令人胆寒。
examples.en: The thug's fierce look chilled everyone.

examples.zh: 战争暴露了侵略者面目狰狞的一面。
examples.en: The war exposed the invaders' vicious true face.

meaning.en: To sigh repeatedly from distress or worry.
meaning.zh: 因苦闷、忧愁而不断叹气。

examples.zh: 他整天长吁短叹，愁眉不展。
examples.en: He sighs all day with a furrowed brow.

examples.zh: 别光在那儿长吁短叹，想想办法吧。
examples.en: Don't just sit sighing; think of something.

examples.zh: 考试失利后，她长吁短叹了好几天。
examples.en: After failing the exam she sighed about it for days.

meaning.en: To raise an arm and call, rallying many to follow.
meaning.zh: 举起手臂高声呼喊，号召大家行动。

examples.zh: 他振臂一呼，群众纷纷响应。
examples.en: He raised his arm and the people answered in droves.

examples.zh: 只要你振臂一呼，我们就跟着干。
examples.en: If you call us to action, we'll follow.

examples.zh: 明星振臂一呼，募得巨款。
examples.en: One call from the star raised a huge sum.

usage.en: Often followed by 应者云集.

meaning.en: Not needing to lock doors at night; a safe, orderly society.
meaning.zh: 夜里不用关门，形容社会治安良好。

examples.zh: 那时村里路不拾遗，夜不闭户。
examples.en: In those days villagers left lost items on the road and doors unlocked at night.

examples.zh: 这座小城至今仍夜不闭户。
examples.en: This small town still leaves its doors unlocked at night.

examples.zh: 理想的社会应当夜不闭户。
examples.en: An ideal society is one where nobody locks up at night.

usage.en: Often paired with 路不拾遗.

meaning.en: To pursue private gain by shameless, underhand means.
meaning.zh: 像苍蝇一样钻营，像狗一样苟且，形容不择手段地谋取私利。

examples.zh: 他一辈子蝇营狗苟，最终身败名裂。
examples.en: He schemed all his life and ended in disgrace.

examples.zh: 不要为了蝇营狗苟之事浪费精力。
examples.en: Don't waste energy on petty, underhand pursuits.

examples.zh: 那些蝇营狗苟之徒终将受到惩罚。
examples.en: Those who grub for gain by foul means will be punished.

story.en: Han Yu's 'Sending Off Poverty' speaks of 'buzzing like flies and fawning like dogs' (蝇营狗苟) in the pursuit of gain.
story.zh: 韩愈《送穷文》：“蝇营狗苟，驱去复还。”

meaning.en: To display oneself or one's abilities, often to draw attention.
meaning.zh: 有意展现自己的才能，希望引起别人注意。

examples.zh: 他在会上过分自我表现，惹人反感。
examples.en: He showed off too much at the meeting and put people off.

examples.zh: 孩子喜欢自我表现，需要正确引导。
examples.en: Children like self-expression and need guidance.

examples.zh: 这个节目给了年轻人自我表现的舞台。
examples.en: The show gave young people a stage to express themselves.

pinyin: zhēn jīn bù pà huǒ liàn
literal: real · gold · not · fear · fire · refine

meaning.en: Genuine quality or integrity stands up to any test.
meaning.zh: 真金不怕烈火冶炼，比喻真正有本事、有品质的人经得起考验。

equivalents: the real thing stands the test

examples.zh: 我们的产品质量过硬，真金不怕火炼。
examples.en: Our product quality is solid; true gold fears no fire.

examples.zh: 真金不怕火炼，清者自清。
examples.en: Real gold fears no fire, and the innocent stay clear.

examples.zh: 你尽管调查，真金不怕火炼。
examples.en: Investigate all you like; I have nothing to fear.

meaning.en: Strong and refusing to give in.
meaning.zh: 意志坚定，不向困难或压力低头。

examples.zh: 她以坚强不屈的精神战胜了病魔。
examples.en: She beat her illness with an indomitable spirit.

examples.zh: 革命者坚强不屈，宁死不降。
examples.en: The revolutionaries were unyielding and would die before surrendering.

examples.zh: 这个民族有着坚强不屈的性格。
examples.en: This people have an unyielding character.

natural: an object brings someone to mind

meaning.en: Seeing an object left behind and thinking of its owner.
meaning.zh: 看到遗留下来的东西，就想起它的主人。

equivalents: be reminded of someone by their belongings

examples.zh: 看着母亲留下的毛衣，他睹物思人，泪流满面。
examples.en: Looking at the sweater his mother left, he thought of her and wept.

examples.zh: 整理旧物时，难免睹物思人。
examples.en: Sorting through old things, one can't help remembering the owner.

examples.zh: 这张照片让她睹物思人。
examples.en: The photo made her think of the one she had lost.

meaning.en: Something that has lost its value or timeliness, like chrysanthemums after the festival.
meaning.zh: 重阳节过后的菊花，比喻过时的事物或失去价值的东西。

examples.zh: 这些旧观念早已是明日黄花。
examples.en: These old ideas are long since yesterday's news.

examples.zh: 过期的消息只是明日黄花。
examples.en: Out-of-date news is yesterday's news.

examples.zh: 曾经的辉煌如今已成明日黄花。
examples.en: Past glories are now a thing of the past.

story.en: Su Shi's poem: 'Wait till tomorrow, the chrysanthemums will be past blooming, even the butterflies will grieve' (明日黄花蝶也愁).
story.zh: 苏轼：“相逢不用忙归去，明日黄花蝶也愁。”

usage.en: Often 已成/成了明日黄花.

meaning.en: To look for a better job elsewhere; also a polite way of saying someone has left or been let go.
meaning.zh: 另外去找更好的职位，也常委婉地指辞职或被辞退。

equivalents: move on to a better job

examples.zh: 他已经另谋高就，不在本公司了。
examples.en: He has moved on to a better job and left the company.

examples.zh: 如果觉得待遇不好，你可以另谋高就。
examples.en: If you're unhappy with the pay, you can look elsewhere.

examples.zh: 公司裁员后，不少员工只好另谋高就。
examples.en: After the layoffs many staff had to find work elsewhere.

usage.zh: 客气或委婉，有时带讽刺。

meaning.en: Winding and roundabout; of roads, routes or processes.
meaning.zh: 道路、过程等弯弯曲曲，不直接。

examples.zh: 山路迂回曲折，开车要小心。
examples.en: The mountain road twists and winds, so drive carefully.

examples.zh: 谈判过程迂回曲折，几经反复。
examples.en: The negotiations were tortuous, with several reversals.

examples.zh: 故事情节迂回曲折，引人入胜。
examples.en: The plot twists and turns and is gripping.

meaning.en: People everywhere are like one family.
meaning.zh: 天下人如同一家，形容天下太平、团结友爱。

equivalents: all the world is one family

examples.zh: 奥运会倡导四海一家的精神。
examples.en: The Olympics promotes the spirit of one global family.

examples.zh: 在这里，大家四海一家，互相帮助。
examples.en: Here we are one big family and help each other.

examples.zh: 无论国籍，四海一家。
examples.en: Whatever our nationality, we are one family.

meaning.en: A great upgrade in equipment or circumstances.
meaning.zh: 比喻条件、装备等大为改善。

examples.zh: 公司买了新设备，真是鸟枪换炮。
examples.en: With the new equipment, the company has gone from popgun to cannon.

examples.zh: 他从旧手机换成最新款，鸟枪换炮了。
examples.en: He switched from his old phone to the newest model, a huge upgrade.

examples.zh: 如今村里鸟枪换炮，家家住新楼。
examples.en: Now the village has transformed and every home has a new building.

usage.en: Casual; often 来了个鸟枪换炮.

meaning.en: Looking fiercely murderous or menacing.
meaning.zh: 形容气势汹汹，充满杀机。

examples.zh: 一群人杀气腾腾地冲了进来。
examples.en: A mob burst in looking murderous.

examples.zh: 他杀气腾腾的眼神令人害怕。
examples.en: His murderous stare was frightening.

examples.zh: 两军对垒，杀气腾腾。
examples.en: The two armies faced off, bristling with menace.

pinyin: lái ér bù wǎng fēi lǐ yě
literal: come · but · not · go · not · courtesy · particle
natural: it is discourteous not to reciprocate

meaning.en: It is impolite to receive without giving back; also used to justify a return blow.
meaning.zh: 别人来而我不去回应，是不合礼节的。也用来表示对别人的行为予以回敬。

examples.zh: 你送了礼，我也该回礼，来而不往非礼也。
examples.en: You sent a gift, so I should send one back; it is discourteous not to reciprocate.

examples.zh: 他们先动手，我们也要还击，来而不往非礼也。
examples.en: They struck first, and we'll hit back; it's only proper to return the favour.

examples.zh: 既然对方已经敬酒，来而不往非礼也，我也敬一杯。
examples.en: They've toasted me; to be courteous I'll toast them back.

story.en: Book of Rites: 'To go and not receive in return is discourteous; to come and not go in return is also discourteous.'
story.zh: 《礼记》：“往而不来，非礼也；来而不往，亦非礼也。”

usage.en: A saying; can be humorous or defiant.
